title: Rabbi Ilai bar Berakhyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Taanit 10b, and four times in Sotah 49b as Rabbi Ilea ben Yevarekhya. Hyman reports that in Sanhedrin 94b, according to Dikdukei Soferim, the reading is Rabbi Ilea ben Yevarekhya, whereas our text has Rabbi Elazar bar Berakhyah. For Sanhedrin 104b, Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads: “Rabbi Ila ben Berakhyah said in the name of Rabbi Yohanan”; Ein Yaakov reads: “Rabbi Ilai bar Berakhyah said in the name of Rabbi Yohanan: Whoever oppresses Israel does not tire.”

notes.text: The different patronymics are reported textual variants. “Ein Yaakov” expands ע״י; it does not mean “the printed editions.”

The consulted William Davidson text places all four Ilai bar Yevrekhiah occurrences on Sotah 49a; Hyman’s supplied 49b is retained. The consulted Sanhedrin 104b attributes the saying to Rava. Hyman’s distinct Dikdukei Soferim and Ein Yaakov readings are reported here without direct inspection of those editions.
